captures.notes: Fourteen connected narrow/tall stacks form a compact stepped mass. Authored light boards cover the structural courts; no dark duplicate surface is visible.
The reverse overview shows extensive intermediate floors and overhangs. Only isolated guarded lightwells remain; there is no broad contiguous core shaft to grass.
The section confirms staggered rooflines, complete pitched caps, supported overhangs, and no visually one-storey wide building.
After strengthening camera clearance to a player-sized bubble, the entry reads as a stocked market alley bounded by facades and overhead construction rather than a frame buried in a stall post.
The addressed upper route is continuously planked and guarded. Platform render material remains light and collision geometry does not bleed through it.
The dimension-aware camera exposes more of the link than the diagonal recipe, but dense endpoint towers still make the complete occupied-link silhouette difficult to judge in this frame.
The underside view verifies occupied horizontal mass and a second public layer above an exterior undercroft. The open grass is at the perimeter/undercroft edge, not a multi-column central shaft.
Every visible inhabited stack and outcropping terminates in a pitched roof; no flat open room shell or missing gable side is visible.

findings.evidence: The target is collision-clear and visible, and the new camera is aligned across the measured short axis, but adjacent towers still occupy most of the frame and prevent an unambiguous whole-link silhouette review.
findings.invariant: A named hostile capture must communicate the whole construction relationship, not merely reach a target face.

fixed_during_review.issue: The original entry camera accepted a point close enough to a stall post for the post and canopies to obscure most of the frame.
fixed_during_review.fix: Camera acceptance now reserves a 0.65 m physics sphere and a 0.55 m visual-clearance margin.
fixed_during_review.regression_evidence: The recaptured entry remains collision-clear with 0.78 target visibility and presents a legible market alley.
